heading: Recommended legislation
lead: If the Director of the Office of Management and Budget determines that the results and findings under the pilot program under this chapter indicate that legislation is necessary or desirable to improve the process for acquisition of information technology, the Director shall transmit the Director’s recommendations for that legislation to Congress.

notes.text: 2002—Pub. L. 107–314 and Pub. L. 107–347 amended section identically, substituting “the pilot” for “a pilot”.

notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 107–347 effective 120 days after Dec. 17, 2002, see section 402(a) of Pub. L. 107–347, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3601 of Title 44, Public Printing and Documents.
